sentences.text: You'd worried the staffing explanation in the library proposal was too dense; when Jo returned it, she liked the floor plan but couldn't see how the evening shift would work.
You were embarrassed at first, then grateful she'd pointed to something specific.
Turning the evening-shift section into a worked example exposed a gap in the handover, so the rota changed too; redoing it was frustrating, but you could finally explain who would be there.
Jo read the revision and said the evening cover was clear now.
You were pleased with that change and tired of looking at the document, and you're still nervous about next week's committee presentation.
你原本担心图书馆提案里人员安排那段写得太绕；小乔发回来时，喜欢平面图，却没看懂晚班怎么安排。
你先是有点不好意思，后来又很感谢她指得这么具体。
把晚班安排改成具体例子后，才发现交接还有空档，连排班表也重做了；返工挺烦，但终于能说清楚谁在什么时段值班。
小乔再看时，说晚班安排清楚了。
你对这处修改挺满意，也实在不想再盯着这份文档；下周向委员会展示，想到还是紧张。
You know Sam is caring for her dad and don't blame her for cancelling dinner again, but you still felt hurt after keeping the evening free.

You told her you missed her and felt disappointed and asked whether a short walk would be easier, nervous about sounding demanding; she said a walk would be easier and thanked you for saying how you felt, which relieved you.
There's no time picked for the walk yet, and you still wish you'd had the dinner.
On the bus, a funny essay made you laugh at the bit about the missing suitcase.
你知道小珊在照顾爸爸，也不怪她又取消晚饭，可特意空出了晚上，还是有点受伤。
你给她发消息，说想她、有点失落，问短时间散个步会不会方便些，发完又忐忑，怕显得要求太多；她回复说散步方便些，也谢谢你把感受告诉她，你松了口气。
没能一起吃那顿饭，仍有点遗憾，散步的时间也还没定。
在公交车上读到一篇好笑的散文，写丢行李箱那段让你笑出了声。
You liked the crooked cranes in your harbour sketch and wanted to keep them.
The first test print lost the water completely in a dark block, and you were disappointed.
Cutting thin channels through that dark water brought the water back, but the cranes looked too tidy, and you missed their crookedness.
You redrew them from the original sketch and cut them unevenly; the new test kept the water lines and brought back the awkward cranes, closer to what you'd wanted, and you were pleased.
The latest test print is on the shelf, and you like looking at it there; the paper for the final edition isn't chosen yet.
港口版画一开始，你就喜欢草图里那些歪歪的起重机，想把它们留下来。
第一次试印，水面全糊成了黑块，你有点失望。
在黑色水面刻出细线后，水出来了，起重机却显得太规整，你还是喜欢原来歪歪的样子。
你照着最初的草图重画起重机，刻得不那么齐；这次试印，水面的线还在，歪歪的起重机也回来了，比较像一开始想做的，你挺开心。
最新那张试印摆上了架子，你看着挺喜欢；正式印制用什么纸，还没选。
The washing machine leaked again and you spent the evening drying the floor, fed up; you were still irritated about it later, and the repair visit is booked but the machine isn't fixed.
You also kept remembering the last song from the small concert with Lee, which you both loved; you enjoyed walking back together talking about the drummer, and it was a lovely evening.
Covering the early shift at short notice left you annoyed and tired.
The first ripe tomato from your balcony, eaten with toast, was so sweet you were absurdly pleased.
洗衣机又漏水，你擦了一晚上地，真有点烦透了，后来想到还是烦；维修约好了，人还没来，机器也还没修好。
你也总会想起和小黎听的那场小演出：你们都很喜欢最后那首歌，回去一起走路聊鼓手，那天晚上确实很开心。
临时顶早班让你有点恼火，到的时候也很累。
阳台上第一颗番茄熟了，配吐司吃掉，甜得你特别高兴。
The lentil soup needed more lemon than the recipe said, and you liked it with yesterday's bread.
The loose button is back on your blue coat; the thread doesn't quite match, but it stays put.
A detective story's surprising ending sent you back to reread the conversation in the kitchen scene.
扁豆汤里的柠檬汁比方子多放了些，配昨天剩的面包，你挺喜欢。
蓝外套上松掉的扣子缝好了，线颜色不太配，扣子倒很牢。
侦探小说的结尾挺意外，你又翻回去读了厨房里对话那段。
The writing residency rejected your application, and you'd wanted that time away for the canal essays; you were upset and didn't open the essay folder that day.
When you did open them, you shortened the opening of the lock-keeper piece and liked the new opening, though the rejection still upset you.
You enjoyed the editing, but it hasn't made the rejection feel fine.
You told Noor about it over noodles; she listened without trying to make it sound like good news, and you were glad you'd told her.
Whether to apply elsewhere is still undecided.
写作驻留的申请没通过，你本来很想用那段时间专心写运河散文；那天挺难受，没打开散文文件夹。
后来打开运河散文，你把写船闸管理员那篇的开头删短了，挺喜欢新开头，但落选的事还是让你难受。
改散文是开心的，却并没有因此觉得落选也没什么。
和小诺吃面时你说了这件事，她听着，没有非要把它说成好事，你挺庆幸跟她说了。
要不要申请别的地方，你还没决定。
Space for larger drawings is what excites you about the studio across town Ari suggested sharing; the rent is what worried you.
You didn't know whether the price included heating, and the landlord wasn't there when you visited, though you liked the north window and left interested and uneasy.
The landlord has since confirmed heating is included, which relieved you about that particular cost.
Whether the total rent fits your budget is still to be worked out.
You told Ari you'd like another visit before deciding, and you haven't agreed to move.
城另一头那间工作室能让你画大画，你一直挺期待；让你担心的是租金。
起初不知道报价包不包暖气，看房时房东不在，也没问清楚；你喜欢那扇朝北的窗，出来时很有兴趣，又有点不踏实。
后来房东确认租金包含暖气，这笔费用让你松了口气。
总租金能不能负担，还得算一算。
你跟阿黎说，决定之前还想再看一次，也没有答应搬过去。
At the workshop you learned to replace a bicycle brake cable, and you were pleased when the brake worked on the test ride.
Your cousin called to say she'd got the bakery job and sounded excited; you congratulated her while waiting for the bus.
In the gallery, you liked the unfinished hand of a charcoal portrait more than the face, and you didn't make any drawings of your own that day.
The upstairs neighbours moved out; the hallway was full of boxes when you went for the post, and you don't know who is moving in.
修车课上你学着换了自行车刹车线，试骑时刹车正常，挺高兴。
表姐打电话说拿到了面包店的工作，听起来很兴奋，你等公交时跟她说了恭喜。
在画廊看炭笔肖像时，比起脸，你更喜欢那只没画完的手；那天你自己没有画画。
楼上的邻居搬走了，你去拿信时走廊里都是箱子，还不知道接下来谁搬来。
You bought pears and read at home.
买了梨，也在家看了书。
